arabic.label: Arabic — Alif Baa: Introduction to Arabic Letters and Sounds, 3e (Brustad/Al-Batal/Al-Tonsi)
arabic.notes: RUN A UNIT VIA reference/arabic-unit-playbook.md (end-to-end sequence, guards, Lingco harvest recipe, letter-extension policy for Units 2-10). SCAN with English-only OCR: the text layer contains ZERO Arabic codepoints (verified 2026-08-08 across all 251 pages). Every Arabic-bearing card MUST carry visual evidence (back-side source crop) and/or external authority. Authoritative Unicode Arabic for course-overlapping content: Lingco Classroom lesson JSON (class.lingco.io /api/content/lessons/<id>; Unit 1 vocab = lesson 8174), snapshot in work/arabic/. Course = MSA (Formal) — dialect columns go to Back Extra, not their own cards. RTL rules: stacked divs with dir attrs, never inline-mix Arabic+Latin, translit is answer-side only, diacritics ride carrier letters. Letter pron videos: local archive 'Anki Media Archive/Arabic - Al-Kitaab pronunciation'. Offset printed→physical is NOT constant (drifts +14→+17); map uses verified physical opener pages.

lydia-anatomy.label: Lydia — Exploring Creation with Advanced Biology: The Human Body (Shannon & Yunis, 2013)
lydia-anatomy.notes: LYDIA'S SOURCE, NOT PARKER'S — reads from the 'Lydia Coursework' group (groupID 6638565, libraryID 2), never the personal library. Cards are written into Parker's Anki under 'not my decks::Lydia::...' so he can review and edit them, and are ALWAYS SUSPENDED on write; that tree is his existing convention for other people's decks (103k cards, zero ever due). Deliver with `lydia.py export`, which forces includeSched=False — exporting WITH scheduling preserves queue=-1 and Lydia would import a deck where no card ever appears, with no error to explain it (verified by experiment 2026-08-13). Notes carry a zk::<annotation-key> tag so re-runs update instead of duplicating. segment_noun 'Module' follows the Apologia series convention but is UNCONFIRMED — the group PDFs are not full-text indexed yet. No segments map exists; her current highlights all sit in pp. 3-13. TWO-COLUMN SCAN: pages are two columns on a 549.8pt-wide page; read straight across, pdftotext interleaves them into nonsense and destroys the grounding context. text_columns=2 with column_split_pts=270 (tuned — the midpoint 275 bleeds the right column's first letters into the left).
